q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा ज्योति तीव्रता (luminous intensity) का SI मात्रक है?
e: Candela (cd) is the SI base unit of luminous intensity (ज्योति तीव्रता का SI मूल मात्रक कैंडेला है). Exam Boosters: (1) Lumen (lm) is the SI unit of luminous flux; (2) Lux (lx = lm/m²) is the SI unit of illuminance; (3) Weber (Wb) is the SI unit of magnetic flux (Tesla = Wb/m² is magnetic flux density); (4) The 7 SI base units are metre, kilogram, second, ampere, kelvin, mole, and candela.
qe: Which of the following is the SI unit of luminous intensity?

q: दंत चिकित्सकों द्वारा दाँतों का बड़ा और सीधा प्रतिबिंब प्राप्त करने के लिए किस प्रकार के दर्पण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: A concave mirror (अवतल दर्पण) forms a virtual, erect, and magnified image when the object is placed between the pole (P) and principal focus (F). Exam Boosters: (1) Concave mirrors are also used in shaving mirrors, vehicle headlights, and solar concentrators; (2) Convex mirrors always form virtual, erect, and diminished images, so they are used as rear-view mirrors in vehicles; (3) Mirror formula: 1/f = 1/v + 1/u; (4) Magnification m = −v/u = hᵢ/hₒ.
qe: Which type of mirror is used by dentists to obtain an enlarged, erect image of teeth?

q: दिन के समय स्वच्छ आकाश का नीला रंग मुख्य रूप से किस प्रकाशिक परिघटना के कारण होता है?
e: The blue colour of the sky is caused by Rayleigh scattering of sunlight by atmospheric gas molecules (वायुमंडलीय अणुओं द्वारा प्रकाश के रैले प्रकीर्णन के कारण). Exam Boosters: (1) According to Rayleigh's law, scattering intensity I ∝ 1/λ⁴, so shorter wavelengths (violet/blue) scatter much more than red; (2) Red light has the longest wavelength in the visible spectrum (~700 nm), hence danger signals are red and the sun appears reddish at sunrise/sunset; (3) Tyndall effect is scattering of light by colloidal particles; (4) Without an atmosphere (e.g., on the Moon), the sky appears black.
qe: The blue colour of the clear sky during daytime is primarily due to which optical phenomenon?

q: एक स्वस्थ मानव कान के लिए अनुमानित श्रव्य आवृत्ति परास (audible frequency range) क्या है?
e: A healthy human ear can detect sound waves with frequencies between 20 Hz and 20,000 Hz (20 kHz) (स्वस्थ मानव कान 20 Hz से 20,000 Hz तक की ध्वनि सुन सकता है). Exam Boosters: (1) Sound below 20 Hz is infrasonic (heard by elephants, whales, and produced by earthquakes); (2) Sound above 20,000 Hz is ultrasonic (used by bats, dolphins, SONAR, and medical ultrasonography); (3) Speed of sound in dry air at 20°C is ~343 m/s and increases with temperature (v ∝ √T); (4) Sound waves are longitudinal mechanical waves and cannot travel through vacuum.
qe: What is the approximate audible frequency range for a healthy human ear?

q:
निम्नलिखित वैज्ञानिक उपकरणों को उनके द्वारा मापी जाने वाली भौतिक राशियों से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. हाइग्रोमीटर — (a) वायुमंडलीय दाब
2. बैरोमीटर — (b) आपेक्षिक आर्द्रता
3. एनीमोमीटर — (c) रक्तचाप
4. स्फिग्मोमैनोमीटर — (d) पवन वेग
e: Hygrometer measures relative humidity, Barometer measures atmospheric pressure, Anemometer measures wind speed, and Sphygmomanometer measures blood pressure (सही मिलान 1-b, 2-a, 3-d, 4-c है). Exam Boosters: (1) Hydrometer (not hygrometer) measures relative density/specific gravity of liquids; (2) Lactometer measures purity/density of milk; (3) Pyrometer measures very high temperatures (e.g., furnaces, Sun); (4) Sudden fall in barometer reading indicates an approaching storm.
qe:
Match the following scientific instruments with the physical quantities they measure:
1. Hygrometer — (a) Atmospheric pressure
2. Barometer — (b) Relative humidity
3. Anemometer — (c) Blood pressure
4. Sphygmomanometer — (d) Wind speed

q: मानव दृष्टि के निम्नलिखित में से किस दोष को बेलनाकार लेंस (cylindrical lens) द्वारा ठीक किया जाता है?
e: Astigmatism (अबिंदुकता), caused by irregular curvature of the cornea or eye lens, is corrected using a cylindrical lens (बेलनाकार लेंस से ठीक किया जाता है). Exam Boosters: (1) Myopia (near-sightedness / निकट दृष्टि दोष) is corrected by a concave (diverging) lens; (2) Hypermetropia (far-sightedness / दूर दृष्टि दोष) is corrected by a convex (converging) lens; (3) Presbyopia (जरा दूरदर्शिता) in old age is corrected using bifocal lenses; (4) Power of a lens P = 1/f (in metres), measured in Dioptre (D).
qe: Which of the following defects of human vision is corrected using a cylindrical lens?

q: किस तापमान पर सेल्सियस और फ़ारेनहाइट पैमाने बिल्कुल समान संख्यात्मक पाठ्यांक दर्शाते हैं?
e: Using C/5 = (F − 32)/9 and putting C = F = x: 9x = 5x − 160 ⇒ 4x = −160 ⇒ x = −40° (अतः −40°C = −40°F). Exam Boosters: (1) Normal human body temperature is 37°C = 98.6°F = 310.15 K; (2) Absolute zero is 0 K = −273.15°C; (3) Water has maximum density (~1000 kg/m³) and minimum volume at 4°C (anomalous expansion of water); (4) Kelvin scale has no negative temperatures and is the SI unit of temperature.
qe: At what temperature do the Celsius and Fahrenheit scales show the exact same numerical reading?

q: घरेलू विद्युत परिपथों में प्रयुक्त फ्यूज तार के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
o: It is connected in series with the live wire.
It works on the magnetic effect of electric current.
It is commonly made of an alloy of tin and lead.
It has a low melting point and high resistivity.
e: An electric fuse works on the heating effect of electric current (Joule's law: H = I²Rt), NOT the magnetic effect (फ्यूज विद्युत धारा के ऊष्मीय प्रभाव पर कार्य करता है, चुंबकीय प्रभाव पर नहीं). Exam Boosters: (1) Fuse wire is an alloy of Tin (~63%) and Lead (~37%) with low melting point and high resistance; (2) MCB (Miniature Circuit Breaker) works on both thermal and magnetic effects and can be reset; (3) Domestic appliances in India are connected in parallel at 220 V, 50 Hz AC; (4) Nichrome (Ni + Cr + Fe) is used in heating coils due to high resistivity and high melting point.
qe: Which of the following statements about an electric fuse wire used in domestic circuits is NOT correct?
oe: It is connected in series with the live wire.
It works on the magnetic effect of electric current.
It is commonly made of an alloy of tin and lead.
It has a low melting point and high resistivity.

q: 6 Ω और 3 Ω के दो प्रतिरोधक 6 V की बैटरी के साथ समांतर क्रम में जुड़े हैं। बैटरी से प्रवाहित कुल विद्युत धारा कितनी है?
e: Equivalent resistance in parallel: 1/R_eq = 1/6 + 1/3 = 3/6 = 1/2 ⇒ R_eq = 2 Ω. By Ohm's law (ओम के नियम से): I = V / R_eq = 6 / 2 = 3 A. Exam Boosters: (1) In series, R_eq = R₁ + R₂ and current is same through all resistors; (2) In parallel, voltage is same across all resistors and R_eq is smaller than the smallest resistor; (3) Electrical power P = VI = I²R = V²/R; (4) 1 commercial unit (1 kWh) = 3.6 × 10⁶ Joules.
qe: Two resistors of 6 Ω and 3 Ω are connected in parallel across a 6 V battery. What is the total current drawn from the battery?

q: नाभिकीय रिएक्टर में भारी जल (D₂O) या ग्रेफाइट का मुख्य उपयोग किस रूप में किया जाता है?
e: Heavy water (D₂O) and graphite act as moderators (मंदक) to slow down fast-moving neutrons produced during fission so they can sustain the U-235 chain reaction. Exam Boosters: (1) Control rods are made of Cadmium or Boron, which absorb excess neutrons; (2) Coolants (liquid sodium, CO₂, or pressurized water) transfer heat to generate steam; (3) Common nuclear fuels are U-235 and Pu-239; (4) Nuclear fission was discovered by Otto Hahn and Fritz Strassmann (1938), while the Sun's energy comes from nuclear fusion.
qe: In a nuclear reactor, heavy water (D₂O) or graphite is primarily used as a:

q:
पूर्ण आंतरिक परावर्तन (TIR) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: TIR होने के लिए प्रकाश को विरल माध्यम से सघन माध्यम में जाना आवश्यक है।
कथन II: हीरे का चमकना और रेगिस्तान में मृगमरीचिका का बनना TIR के उदाहरण हैं।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Statement I is incorrect because TIR requires light to travel from an optically DENSER medium to a RARER medium at an angle of incidence greater than the critical angle (सघन से विरल माध्यम में जाना आवश्यक है). Statement II is correct. Exam Boosters: (1) Critical angle sin(i_c) = 1/μ; (2) Refractive index of diamond is ~2.42, giving a very small critical angle (~24.4°); (3) Optical fibres and medical endoscopes also operate on TIR; (4) Looming in cold polar regions is another example of TIR.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding Total Internal Reflection (TIR):
Statement I: Light must travel from an optically rarer medium to an optically denser medium for TIR to occur.
Statement II: Sparkling of a diamond and mirage formation in deserts are examples of TIR.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q:
प्रत्यावर्ती धारा (AC) परिपथों में ट्रांसफॉर्मर के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: ट्रांसफॉर्मर अन्योन्य प्रेरण के सिद्धांत पर कार्य करता है और केवल प्रत्यावर्ती धारा (AC) पर काम करता है।
कथन II: एक उच्चायी (step-up) ट्रांसफॉर्मर वोल्टेज और विद्युत धारा दोनों को एक साथ बढ़ाता है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Statement I is correct (ट्रांसफॉर्मर अन्योन्य प्रेरण पर कार्य करता है). Statement II is incorrect because by conservation of energy (V_p I_p = V_s I_s for an ideal transformer), a step-up transformer increases voltage while DECREASING current. Exam Boosters: (1) Transformation ratio: V_s/V_p = N_s/N_p = I_p/I_s; (2) Laminated soft iron core is used to minimize eddy current and hysteresis losses; (3) A rectifier converts AC to DC, whereas an inverter converts DC to AC; (4) Frequency of AC does not change across a transformer.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding transformers in AC circuits:
Statement I: A transformer works on the principle of mutual induction and operates only on alternating current (AC).
Statement II: A step-up transformer increases both the voltage and the electric current simultaneously.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: एक अवतल लेंस की फोकस दूरी 25 सेमी है। डायोप्टर में इसकी प्रकाशिक क्षमता (power) क्या है?
e: By sign convention, focal length of a concave (diverging) lens is negative: f = −25 cm = −0.25 m. Power P = 1/f (in metres) = 1/(−0.25) = −4.0 D (अवतल लेंस की क्षमता ऋणात्मक होती है, अतः −4.0 D). Exam Boosters: (1) Convex lens has positive focal length and positive power; (2) When two thin lenses of powers P₁ and P₂ are kept in contact, net power P = P₁ + P₂; (3) A lens immersed in a liquid of equal refractive index behaves like a plane glass plate (P = 0, f = ∞); (4) Least distance of distinct vision for a normal human eye is 25 cm.
qe: A concave lens has a focal length of 25 cm. What is its optical power in Dioptres?

q: रसोईघर और प्रतिअम्लों (antacids) में सामान्यतः प्रयुक्त 'बेकिंग सोडा' का रासायनिक नाम क्या है?
e: Baking soda is Sodium bicarbonate or Sodium hydrogen carbonate (NaHCO₃) (बेकिंग सोडा का रासायनिक नाम सोडियम बाइकार्बोनेट है). Exam Boosters: (1) Washing soda is Sodium carbonate decahydrate (Na₂CO₃·10H₂O); (2) Caustic soda is Sodium hydroxide (NaOH); (3) Bleaching powder is Calcium oxychloride (CaOCl₂); (4) Baking powder is a mixture of NaHCO₃ and a mild edible acid like tartaric acid.
qe: What is the chemical name of 'Baking Soda' commonly used in kitchens and antacids?

q: इमली और अंगूर में प्राकृतिक रूप से कौन-सा अम्ल पाया जाता है?
e: Tartaric acid (टार्टरिक अम्ल) is naturally present in tamarind and grapes. Exam Boosters: (1) Citric acid is found in lemons and oranges; (2) Acetic acid (CH₃COOH) is present in vinegar (5–8% solution); (3) Oxalic acid is found in tomatoes and spinach (used to remove rust stains); (4) Formic (methanoic) acid is injected by ant stings and nettle leaves, while lactic acid is in curd.
qe: Which acid is naturally present in tamarind (imli) and grapes?

q: कांसा (Bronze), जिसका उपयोग मूर्तियाँ, पदक और सिक्के बनाने में होता है, मुख्यतः किसका मिश्रण है?
e: Bronze (कांसा) is an alloy of Copper (~88%) and Tin (~12%) (ताँबा और टिन की मिश्रधातु). Exam Boosters: (1) Brass (पीतल) = Copper + Zinc; (2) Solder (टाँका) = Lead + Tin; (3) Stainless steel = Iron + Chromium + Nickel + Carbon; (4) German silver contains Copper, Zinc, and Nickel (0% silver!).
qe: Bronze, an alloy widely used in making statues, medals, and coins, is primarily a mixture of:

q: स्वस्थ मानव रक्त का अनुमानित pH मान क्या होता है?
e: Healthy human blood is slightly alkaline with a tightly regulated pH range of 7.35 to 7.45 (~7.4) (स्वस्थ मानव रक्त हल्का क्षारीय होता है, pH ≈ 7.4). Exam Boosters: (1) pH scale (0–14) was introduced by Søren Sørensen in 1909; pH = −log₁₀[H⁺]; (2) Gastric juice (HCl in stomach) has pH ~1.2–2.0; (3) Acid rain occurs when rainwater pH drops below 5.6 (due to SO₂ and NOₓ); (4) Milk of Magnesia (Mg(OH)₂, pH ~10.5) is used as an antacid.
qe: What is the approximate pH value of healthy human blood?

q:
निम्नलिखित सामान्य रासायनिक पदार्थों को उनके रासायनिक सूत्रों से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. प्लास्टर ऑफ पेरिस — (a) CaSO₄·2H₂O
2. जिप्सम — (b) CaSO₄·(1/2)H₂O
3. नीला थोथा — (c) CuSO₄·5H₂O
4. बिना बुझा चूना — (d) CaO
e: Plaster of Paris = CaSO₄·(1/2)H₂O (obtained by heating gypsum at 373 K / 100°C); Gypsum = CaSO₄·2H₂O; Blue Vitriol = CuSO₄·5H₂O; Quick Lime = CaO (सही मिलान 1-b, 2-a, 3-c, 4-d है). Exam Boosters: (1) Slaked lime (बुझा चूना) is Ca(OH)₂; (2) Green vitriol is FeSO₄·7H₂O and White vitriol is ZnSO₄·7H₂O; (3) Gypsum is added to Portland cement to slow down its setting time; (4) Oil of vitriol is concentrated H₂SO₄.
qe:
Match the following common chemical substances with their chemical formulas:
1. Plaster of Paris — (a) CaSO₄·2H₂O
2. Gypsum — (b) CaSO₄·(1/2)H₂O
3. Blue Vitriol — (c) CuSO₄·5H₂O
4. Quick Lime — (d) CaO

q: विस्थानीकृत मुक्त इलेक्ट्रॉनों की उपस्थिति के कारण कार्बन का कौन-सा अपरूप विद्युत का सुचालक है?
e: In graphite (ग्रेफाइट), each carbon atom is sp² hybridized and bonded to three other carbon atoms in hexagonal layers, leaving one free electron per carbon that conducts electricity. Exam Boosters: (1) Diamond has sp³ hybridization in a 3D tetrahedral network, making it the hardest natural substance and an electrical insulator; (2) Buckminsterfullerene (C₆₀) has a soccer-ball shape with 20 hexagons and 12 pentagons; (3) Graphene is a single atomic layer of graphite with exceptional strength and conductivity; (4) Graphite is also used as a dry lubricant in heavy machinery.
qe: Which allotrope of carbon is a good conductor of electricity due to the presence of delocalized free electrons?

q: निम्नलिखित में से किस बहुलक (polymer) का उपयोग बर्तनों पर नॉन-स्टिक परत चढ़ाने के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Teflon, chemically Polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE, monomer CF₂=CF₂), is chemically inert and heat-resistant, making it ideal for non-stick cookware (टेफ्लॉन का उपयोग नॉन-स्टिक बर्तनों में होता है). Exam Boosters: (1) Bakelite (phenol-formaldehyde resin) is a thermosetting plastic used in electrical switches and utensil handles; (2) Natural rubber is a polymer of isoprene, vulcanized by heating with sulphur (Charles Goodyear); (3) Neoprene is synthetic rubber (polymer of chloroprene); (4) Kevlar is used in bulletproof vests.
qe: Which of the following polymers is used as a non-stick coating on cookware?

q: भारत में सर्वाधिक प्रयुक्त नाइट्रोजनयुक्त उर्वरक यूरिया [CO(NH₂)₂] में नाइट्रोजन का अनुमानित प्रतिशत कितना होता है?
e: Molar mass of Urea CO(NH₂)₂ = 12 + 16 + 2(14 + 2) = 60 g/mol. Mass of Nitrogen = 2 × 14 = 28 g. Percentage = (28/60) × 100 ≈ 46.6% (~46%) (यूरिया में लगभग 46% नाइट्रोजन होता है). Exam Boosters: (1) Urea was the first organic compound synthesized in a laboratory (by Friedrich Wöhler in 1828 from ammonium cyanate); (2) NPK fertilizers supply Nitrogen (leaf growth), Phosphorus (root/flowering), and Potassium (overall immunity/fruit quality); (3) Neem-coated urea slows nitrification and prevents illegal industrial diversion; (4) Ammonium sulphate contains ~21% nitrogen.
qe: What is the approximate percentage of nitrogen present in Urea [CO(NH₂)₂], the most widely used nitrogenous fertilizer in India?

q: समस्थानिकों (Isotopes) और समभारिकों (Isobars) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
o: Isotopes have the same atomic number but different mass numbers.
Isotopes of an element always have different chemical properties.
Carbon-14 is a radioactive isotope used in archaeological dating.
Isobars have the same mass number but different atomic numbers.
e: Isotopes of an element have the same atomic number (same number of protons and electrons), so they exhibit almost identical CHEMICAL properties, though their physical properties (density, boiling point) differ (समस्थानिकों के रासायनिक गुण समान होते हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Hydrogen has 3 isotopes: Protium (¹H), Deuterium (²H), and radioactive Tritium (³H); (2) Cobalt-60 is used in cancer radiotherapy; Iodine-131 is used to treat goitre/thyroid disorders; (3) Argon-40, Potassium-40, and Calcium-40 are classic isobars; (4) Isotones have the same number of neutrons.
qe: Which of the following statements about Isotopes and Isobars is NOT correct?
oe: Isotopes have the same atomic number but different mass numbers.
Isotopes of an element always have different chemical properties.
Carbon-14 is a radioactive isotope used in archaeological dating.
Isobars have the same mass number but different atomic numbers.

q:
गैल्वनीकरण और संक्षारण के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: गैल्वनीकरण में लोहे को जंग से बचाने के लिए उस पर जस्ते (जिंक) की पतली परत चढ़ाई जाती है।
कथन II: जिंक की परत खुरच जाने पर भी यह लोहे को जंग से बचाता है क्योंकि जिंक लोहे से अधिक अभिक्रियाशील होकर बलिदानी एनोड का कार्य करता है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Both statements are correct. Galvanization coats iron with zinc, and because zinc sits higher than iron in the electrochemical reactivity series, it oxidizes preferentially (cathodic/sacrificial protection) (दोनों कथन सही हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Chemical formula of rust is hydrated iron(III) oxide, Fe₂O₃·xH₂O; (2) Rusting increases the weight of iron due to addition of oxygen and moisture; (3) Green coating on copper is basic copper carbonate [CuCO₃·Cu(OH)₂]; (4) Tarnishing of silver is due to formation of black silver sulphide (Ag₂S) with H₂S in air.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding Galvanization and Corrosion:
Statement I: Galvanization protects iron from rusting by coating it with a thin layer of Zinc.
Statement II: Even if the zinc coating is scratched, zinc prevents iron from rusting by acting as a sacrificial anode because zinc is more reactive than iron.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q:
अम्लराज (Aqua Regia) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: अम्लराज सांद्र HCl और सांद्र HNO₃ का 3 : 1 के आयतन अनुपात में ताज़ा बना मिश्रण है।
कथन II: यह सोने और प्लैटिनम जैसी उत्कृष्ट धातुओं को घोल सकता है क्योंकि यह नवजात क्लोरीन और नाइट्रोसिल क्लोराइड उत्पन्न करता है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Both statements are correct: Aqua Regia (3 parts conc. HCl + 1 part conc. HNO₃) dissolves gold and platinum by forming soluble chloro-complexes via nascent chlorine [Cl] and NOCl (दोनों कथन सही हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Neither HCl nor HNO₃ alone can dissolve gold; (2) Pure gold is 24 carat; 22 carat gold is 91.6% pure (alloyed with Cu/Ag for hardness); (3) Platinum is also called 'White Gold'; (4) Concentrated H₂SO₄ is called the 'King of Chemicals'.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding Aqua Regia:
Statement I: Aqua Regia is a freshly prepared mixture of concentrated HCl and concentrated HNO₃ in the volume ratio 3 : 1.
Statement II: It can dissolve noble metals like gold and platinum because it generates nascent chlorine and nitrosyl chloride.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: जल की स्थायी कठोरता कैल्शियम और मैग्नीशियम के घुले हुए क्लोराइड और सल्फेट के कारण होती है। स्थायी कठोरता दूर करने के लिए किस विधि का उपयोग नहीं किया जाता?
e: Simple boiling removes ONLY temporary hardness (caused by bicarbonates of Ca and Mg), NOT permanent hardness (उबालने से केवल अस्थायी कठोरता दूर होती है, स्थायी कठोरता नहीं). Exam Boosters: (1) Temporary hardness is removed by boiling or Clark's method (adding slaked lime Ca(OH)₂); (2) Calgon is sodium hexametaphosphate (Na₆P₆O₁₈); (3) Permutit/Zeolite is hydrated sodium aluminium silicate (NaAlSiO₄); (4) Hard water forms insoluble scum with soap instead of lather.
qe: Permanent hardness of water is caused by the presence of dissolved chlorides and sulphates of calcium and magnesium. Which method is NOT used to remove permanent hardness?

q: किस कोशिकांग को 'कोशिका का ऊर्जा गृह' (Powerhouse of the Cell) कहा जाता है क्योंकि यह कोशिकीय श्वसन द्वारा ATP का संश्लेषण करता है?
e: Mitochondria (माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया) generate most of the cell's ATP via aerobic respiration (Krebs cycle and oxidative phosphorylation). Exam Boosters: (1) Mitochondria and Chloroplasts are semi-autonomous organelles containing their own circular DNA and 70S ribosomes; (2) Ribosomes are 'Protein factories' of the cell; (3) Lysosomes are 'Suicidal bags' containing hydrolytic enzymes; (4) Golgi apparatus acts as the packaging and secretion centre.
qe: Which cell organelle is known as the 'Powerhouse of the Cell' because it synthesizes ATP through cellular respiration?

q: कौन-सा पादप ऊतक मुख्य रूप से जड़ों से पत्तियों तक जल और घुले हुए खनिजों के ऊर्ध्वमुखी परिवहन के लिए उत्तरदायी है?
e: Xylem (जाइलम) transports water and minerals unidirectionally from roots to aerial parts via transpiration pull and root pressure. Exam Boosters: (1) Phloem (फ्लोएम) transports prepared food (sucrose) bidirectionally from leaves to other parts (translocation); (2) Parenchyma performs storage and photosynthesis; (3) Collenchyma provides mechanical flexibility to young stems; (4) Sclerenchyma provides hard structural rigidity (dead cells with lignin).
qe: Which plant tissue is primarily responsible for transporting water and dissolved minerals upward from the roots to the leaves?

q:
निम्नलिखित पादप हार्मोनों को उनके प्रमुख कार्यिकीय कार्यों से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. ऑक्सिन — (a) फल पकाना
2. जिबरेलिन — (b) शीर्ष प्रभाविता एवं प्रकाशानुवर्तन
3. साइटोकाइनिन — (c) तने की वृद्धि एवं बीज प्रसुप्ति तोड़ना
4. एथिलीन — (d) कोशिका विभाजन को बढ़ावा देना
e: Auxin controls apical dominance and phototropism; Gibberellin induces stem elongation; Cytokinin stimulates cell division; Ethylene (the only gaseous plant hormone) ripens fruits (सही मिलान 1-b, 2-c, 3-d, 4-a है). Exam Boosters: (1) Abscisic acid (ABA) is the stress/growth-inhibiting hormone that triggers stomatal closure during drought; (2) Artificial fruit ripening uses calcium carbide (releases acetylene) or ethephon (releases ethylene); (3) 2,4-D is a synthetic auxin used as a weedicide; (4) Auxin was first isolated by F. W. Went.
qe:
Match the following plant hormones (phytohormones) with their primary physiological functions:
1. Auxin — (a) Fruit ripening
2. Gibberellin — (b) Apical dominance & phototropism
3. Cytokinin — (c) Stem elongation & breaking seed dormancy
4. Ethylene — (d) Promoting cell division

q: हरे पौधों में प्रकाश संश्लेषण के दौरान वायुमंडल में मुक्त होने वाली ऑक्सीजन गैस (O₂) सीधे किससे प्राप्त होती है?
e: Oxygen released during photosynthesis comes from the photolysis (light-driven splitting) of water (H₂O) in Photosystem II during the light reaction (ऑक्सीजन जल के प्रकाश-अपघटन से प्राप्त होती है). Exam Boosters: (1) Overall equation: 6CO₂ + 12H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ + 6H₂O (in presence of sunlight & chlorophyll); (2) Light reaction occurs in thylakoid membranes (grana), while Calvin cycle (dark reaction) occurs in the stroma of chloroplasts; (3) Magnesium (Mg) is the central metal atom in chlorophyll; (4) Photosynthesis is maximum in red and blue light, and minimum in green light.
qe: During photosynthesis in green plants, the oxygen gas (O₂) released into the atmosphere comes directly from:

q: DNA में पाए जाने वाले थाइमिन (Thymine) के स्थान पर RNA में कौन-सा नाइट्रोजनी क्षारक पाया जाता है?
e: RNA contains Uracil (U) instead of Thymine (T), pairing with Adenine (A) (RNA में थाइमिन के स्थान पर यूरेसिल होता है). Exam Boosters: (1) DNA has deoxyribose sugar and is double-stranded (double helix model by Watson & Crick, 1953); (2) RNA has ribose sugar and is usually single-stranded (mRNA, tRNA, rRNA); (3) Purines are Adenine and Guanine; Pyrimidines are Cytosine, Thymine, and Uracil; (4) In DNA, A pairs with T via 2 hydrogen bonds, and G pairs with C via 3 hydrogen bonds.
qe: Which nitrogenous base is present in RNA in place of Thymine (found in DNA)?

q: टीकों (Vaccines) और प्रतिरक्षा के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
o: BCG vaccine provides protection against Tuberculosis.
Edward Jenner developed the world's first vaccine against Smallpox.
OPV (Sabin vaccine) is an oral live-attenuated vaccine against Polio.
mRNA vaccines permanently alter the recipient's chromosomal DNA.
e: mRNA vaccines NEVER enter the cell nucleus and do NOT alter the recipient's chromosomal DNA; they only instruct ribosomes in the cytoplasm to synthesize a harmless viral protein (spike) to trigger immunity (mRNA टीके मानव DNA में कोई परिवर्तन नहीं करते). Exam Boosters: (1) BCG stands for Bacillus Calmette–Guérin; (2) DPT vaccine protects against Diphtheria, Pertussis (whooping cough), and Tetanus; (3) Jonas Salk developed the Inactivated Polio Vaccine (IPV), while Albert Sabin developed Oral Polio Vaccine (OPV); (4) India was certified polio-free by WHO in March 2014.
qe: Which of the following statements about Vaccines and Immunity is NOT correct?
oe: BCG vaccine provides protection against Tuberculosis.
Edward Jenner developed the world's first vaccine against Smallpox.
OPV (Sabin vaccine) is an oral live-attenuated vaccine against Polio.
mRNA vaccines permanently alter the recipient's chromosomal DNA.

q: CRISPR-Cas9 जीन-संपादन तकनीक में 'Cas9' घटक की विशिष्ट भूमिका क्या है?
o: It acts as a guide RNA locating the target gene.
It transports edited genes across the cell wall.
It synthesizes messenger RNA from amino acids.
It acts as molecular scissors cutting DNA at the target site.
e: Cas9 (CRISPR-associated protein 9) is an endonuclease enzyme that acts as 'molecular scissors' to cut double-stranded DNA at the exact location directed by the guide RNA (gRNA) (Cas9 एक एंजाइम है जो आणविक कैंची की तरह DNA को काटता है). Exam Boosters: (1) Emmanuelle Charpentier and Jennifer Doudna won the 2020 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for developing CRISPR-Cas9; (2) CRISPR stands for Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats; (3) Originally discovered as a bacterial adaptive immune defence against bacteriophages; (4) India's indigenous sickle-cell disease CRISPR research is led by CSIR-IGIB.
qe: In the CRISPR-Cas9 gene-editing technology, what is the specific role of the 'Cas9' component?
oe: It acts as a guide RNA locating the target gene.
It transports edited genes across the cell wall.
It synthesizes messenger RNA from amino acids.
It acts as molecular scissors cutting DNA at the target site.

q:
बीटी कपास (आनुवंशिक रूप से संशोधित फसल) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: इसमें मृदा जीवाणु बैसिलस थुरिंजिएंसिस से प्राप्त जीन समाविष्ट किया जाता है।
कथन II: पौधे द्वारा उत्पादित क्राय (Cry) प्रोटीन बॉलवर्म लार्वा की क्षारीय आँत में विषाक्त हो जाता है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Both statements are correct. Bt cotton expresses Cry1Ac/Cry2Ab protoxins from Bacillus thuringiensis, which convert into active toxins in the alkaline gut pH of bollworm pests (दोनों कथन सही हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Bt Cotton is the ONLY GM crop approved for commercial cultivation in India (approved in 2002 by GEAC); (2) GEAC (Genetic Engineering Appraisal Committee) functions under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC); (3) Golden Rice is genetically engineered to produce beta-carotene (Vitamin A precursor); (4) PCR (Polymerase Chain Reaction) for DNA amplification was invented by Kary Mullis.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding Bt Cotton (genetically modified crop):
Statement I: It incorporates a gene from the soil bacterium Bacillus thuringiensis.
Statement II: The Cry protein produced by the plant is toxic to bollworm larvae in their alkaline gut.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: चंद्रमा के दक्षिणी ध्रुव के निकट भारत के चंद्रयान-3 विक्रम लैंडर के उतरने के स्थान को क्या आधिकारिक नाम दिया गया है?
e: The Chandrayaan-3 landing site (touched down on 23 August 2023) is officially named 'Shiv Shakti Point' (शिव शक्ति पॉइंट), and 23 August is celebrated as National Space Day. Exam Boosters: (1) Chandrayaan-3 was launched by LVM3-M4 (Bahubali rocket) from Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota; (2) Its lander was 'Vikram' and rover was 'Pragyan'; (3) 'Tiranga Point' is the crash site of Chandrayaan-2 (2019), and 'Jawahar Point' is the impact site of Chandrayaan-1 Moon Impact Probe (2008); (4) India became the 1st country to soft-land near the lunar South Pole and 4th overall to soft-land on the Moon.
qe: What is the official name given to the landing site of India's Chandrayaan-3 Vikram lander near the lunar South Pole?

q: भारत की पहली समर्पित अंतरिक्ष-आधारित सौर वेधशाला 'आदित्य-L1' किस लैग्रेंज बिंदु के चारों ओर हेलो कक्षा में स्थापित है?
o: L2 point (~1.5 million km behind Earth)
L1 point (~1.5 million km from Earth)
e: Aditya-L1 orbits around the Sun-Earth Lagrange Point L1 (~1.5 million km from Earth towards the Sun), offering an uninterrupted view of the Sun without eclipses (पृथ्वी से लगभग 15 लाख किमी दूर L1 बिंदु पर). Exam Boosters: (1) Launched on 2 September 2023 aboard PSLV-C57; (2) Carries 7 scientific payloads including VELC (Visible Emission Line Coronagraph) and SUIT; (3) James Webb Space Telescope (NASA/ESA/CSA) is positioned at Sun-Earth L2 point; (4) Lagrange points are 5 positions where gravitational pull of two large bodies balances centripetal force.
qe: Aditya-L1, India's first dedicated space-based solar observatory, is positioned in a halo orbit around which Lagrange point?
oe: L2 point (~1.5 million km behind Earth)
L1 point (~1.5 million km from Earth)

q:
निम्नलिखित भारतीय रक्षा मिसाइल प्रणालियों (DRDO) को उनकी प्रमुख श्रेणी से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. अग्नि-V — (a) सतह से हवा में मार करने वाली मिसाइल
2. आकाश — (b) सुपरसोनिक क्रूज़ मिसाइल
3. ब्रह्मोस — (c) अंतरमहाद्वीपीय बैलिस्टिक मिसाइल
4. नाग — (d) टैंक-रोधी निर्देशित मिसाइल
e: Agni-V is a 5,000+ km range ICBM (with MIRV capability tested under Mission Divyastra); Akash is a medium-range SAM; BrahMos is a Mach 2.8–3.0 Indo-Russian supersonic cruise missile; Nag is a 3rd-gen 'fire-and-forget' ATGM (सही मिलान 1-c, 2-a, 3-b, 4-d है). Exam Boosters: (1) IGMDP (Integrated Guided Missile Development Programme, 1983) by Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam developed Prithvi, Agni, Trishul, Nag, and Akash (PATNA); (2) BrahMos is named after Brahmaputra and Moskva rivers; (3) Barak-8 (MRSAM) is jointly developed by DRDO and Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI); (4) Pralay is India's tactical quasi-ballistic surface-to-surface missile.
qe:
Match the following Indian Defence Missile Systems (DRDO) with their primary category:
1. Agni-V — (a) Surface-to-Air Missile (SAM)
2. Akash — (b) Supersonic Cruise Missile
3. BrahMos — (c) Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM)
4. Nag — (d) Anti-Tank Guided Missile (ATGM)

q: इसरो (ISRO) द्वारा विकसित क्षेत्रीय नेविगेशन प्रणाली 'नाविक' (NavIC) के मूल तारामंडल में कितने प्रमुख उपग्रह शामिल हैं?
e: NavIC (IRNSS) is designed as a constellation of 7 satellites (3 in Geostationary Orbit and 4 in inclined Geosynchronous Orbit) covering India and 1,500 km beyond its borders (नाविक में 7 उपग्रह हैं: 3 भू-स्थिर और 4 भू-तुल्यकालिक). Exam Boosters: (1) Provides Standard Positioning Service (SPS) for civilians and Restricted Service (RS) for defence; (2) Recognized by IMO (International Maritime Organization) as part of the World-Wide Radio Navigation System; (3) Global counterparts: GPS (USA), GLONASS (Russia), Galileo (EU), BeiDou (China); (4) Next-generation NVS-01/NVS-02 satellites carry indigenous Rubidium atomic clocks.
qe: NavIC (Navigation with Indian Constellation), developed by ISRO, consists of how many primary satellites in its regional navigation constellation?

q: भारत के गगनयान मानव अंतरिक्ष उड़ान मिशन के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
o: It uses a human-rated LVM3 (HLVM3) launch vehicle.
It aims to send a 3-member crew to a ~400 km Low Earth Orbit.
'Vyommitra' is the female humanoid robot planned for uncrewed test flights.
It plans to land Indian astronauts on the Moon during its maiden flight.
e: Gaganyaan's maiden crewed mission aims to send astronauts to Low Earth Orbit (~400 km) for ~3 days and safely recover them in Indian waters — NOT to land on the Moon (गगनयान निम्न भू-कक्षा के लिए है, चंद्रमा पर उतरने के लिए नहीं). Exam Boosters: (1) Four IAF astronaut-designates (Group Captains Prashanth Balakrishnan Nair, Ajit Krishnan, Angad Pratap, and Wing Commander Shubhanshu Shukla) were named in 2024; (2) Crew Escape System (CES) was validated via TV-D1 flight test; (3) India's long-term goal includes Bharatiya Antariksh Station (BAS) by 2035 and Indian human lunar landing by 2040; (4) PSLV is called ISRO's 'Workhorse' with 4 stages (Solid-Liquid-Solid-Liquid).
qe: Which of the following statements about India's Gaganyaan Human Spaceflight Mission is NOT correct?
oe: It uses a human-rated LVM3 (HLVM3) launch vehicle.
It aims to send a 3-member crew to a ~400 km Low Earth Orbit.
'Vyommitra' is the female humanoid robot planned for uncrewed test flights.
It plans to land Indian astronauts on the Moon during its maiden flight.

q: भारत के राष्ट्रीय हरित हाइड्रोजन मिशन के अंतर्गत 'हरित हाइड्रोजन' (Green Hydrogen) किस प्रक्रिया द्वारा उत्पादित किया जाता है?
o: Steam methane reforming of natural gas
Electrolysis of water using renewable energy
e: Green Hydrogen is produced by splitting water (H₂O) via electrolysis powered entirely by renewable energy sources like solar or wind, emitting zero carbon (नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा से जल के विद्युत-अपघटन द्वारा हरित हाइड्रोजन बनता है). Exam Boosters: (1) Grey Hydrogen is made from natural gas/coal without carbon capture; (2) Blue Hydrogen uses natural gas with Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS); (3) National Green Hydrogen Mission (approved Jan 2023, outlay ₹19,744 crore) targets 5 MMT annual green hydrogen production by 2030; (4) India aims for 500 GW non-fossil fuel power capacity by 2030 and Net Zero by 2070.
qe: Under India's National Green Hydrogen Mission, 'Green Hydrogen' is produced by which process?
oe: Steam methane reforming of natural gas
Electrolysis of water using renewable energy

q:
इसरो (ISRO) के प्रक्षेपण यानों के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: PSLV में चार-चरणीय प्रणोदन प्रणाली होती है जो ठोस और द्रव चरणों के एकांतर क्रम में कार्य करती है।
कथन II: LVM3 (GSLV Mk-III) में स्वदेशी क्रायोजेनिक ऊपरी चरण (C25) प्रयुक्त होता है जिसमें द्रव हाइड्रोजन और द्रव ऑक्सीजन ईंधन होते हैं।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Both statements are correct. PSLV has 4 stages (Solid-Liquid-Solid-Liquid), while LVM3 has 3 stages: two S200 solid boosters, an L110 liquid core (Vikas engines), and the C25 indigenous cryogenic upper stage using LH₂ (−253°C) and LOX (−183°C) (दोनों कथन सही हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) SSLV (Small Satellite Launch Vehicle) is designed for rapid on-demand launch of mini/micro satellites up to 500 kg to LEO; (2) Vikas engine (liquid stage) uses UDMH fuel and N₂O₄ oxidizer; (3) Cryogenics deals with extremely low temperatures (below −150°C); (4) ISRO was founded on 15 August 1969 with Dr. Vikram Sarabhai as its first chairman.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding ISRO's launch vehicles:
Statement I: PSLV (Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle) uses a four-stage propulsion system alternating between solid and liquid stages.
Statement II: LVM3 (GSLV Mk-III) employs an indigenous cryogenic upper stage (C25) fuelled by liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: डॉ. होमी जे. भाभा द्वारा तैयार भारत के त्रि-चरणीय नाभिकीय ऊर्जा कार्यक्रम का अंतिम लक्ष्य चरण III में किस प्रचुर स्वदेशी खनिज संसाधन का उपयोग करना है?
e: India possesses one of the world's largest reserves of Thorium (found in Monazite sands of Kerala, Odisha, and Andhra Pradesh), which Stage III converts from Th-232 into fissile U-233 (चरण III में थोरियम-232 / मोनाजाइट का उपयोग लक्ष्य है). Exam Boosters: (1) Stage I: Pressurized Heavy Water Reactors (PHWRs) using natural Uranium; (2) Stage II: Fast Breeder Reactors (FBRs, e.g., PFBR at Kalpakkam) using Plutonium-239; (3) Stage III: Advanced Heavy Water Reactors (AHWRs) using Thorium-232/U-233 cycle; (4) Tarapur (Maharashtra, 1969) was India's first nuclear power station, while Narora is UP's nuclear power plant (Bulandshahr).
qe: India's three-stage Nuclear Power Programme (formulated by Dr. Homi J. Bhabha) aims to ultimately utilize which abundant domestic mineral resource in Stage III?

q: पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र में लिंडमैन के ऊर्जा स्थानांतरण के 10% नियम के अनुसार, यदि उत्पादकों के पास 10,000 J ऊर्जा है, तो द्वितीयक उपभोक्ताओं (तृतीय पोषी स्तर) को कितनी ऊर्जा उपलब्ध होगी?
e: Producers (T1) = 10,000 J → Primary consumers/Herbivores (T2) = 10% of 10,000 = 1,000 J → Secondary consumers (T3) = 10% of 1,000 = 100 J (द्वितीयक उपभोक्ताओं को 100 J ऊर्जा मिलेगी). Exam Boosters: (1) The 10% law was proposed by Raymond Lindeman (1942); (2) Energy flow in an ecosystem is always unidirectional, so the pyramid of energy is ALWAYS upright; (3) The term 'Ecosystem' was coined by A. G. Tansley (1935) and 'Ecology' by Ernst Haeckel (1866); (4) 90% of energy at each trophic level is lost as metabolic heat.
qe: According to Lindeman's 10% Law of energy transfer in an ecosystem, if producers capture 10,000 J of energy, how much energy is available to secondary consumers (third trophic level)?

q: मॉन्ट्रियल प्रोटोकॉल (1987) एक ऐतिहासिक अंतर्राष्ट्रीय संधि है जिसका उद्देश्य किन पदार्थों को चरणबद्ध रूप से समाप्त करना है?
e: The Montreal Protocol (signed 16 September 1987, effective 1989) phases out Ozone-Depleting Substances (ODS) such as CFCs and Halons (ओजोन परत क्षरण करने वाले पदार्थों की समाप्ति). Exam Boosters: (1) World Ozone Day is observed annually on 16 September; (2) Ozone layer lies in the Stratosphere (~15–35 km) and absorbs harmful UV-B radiation; thickness is measured in Dobson Units (DU); (3) Kigali Amendment (2016) to the Montreal Protocol targets phasing down HFCs (hydrofluorocarbons, potent greenhouse gases); (4) Vienna Convention (1985) was the framework convention preceding Montreal Protocol.
qe: The Montreal Protocol (1987) is a landmark international treaty aimed at phasing out substances responsible for:

q: रामसर कन्वेंशन (1971) एक अंतर-सरकारी संधि है जो किसके संरक्षण और विवेकपूर्ण उपयोग को समर्पित है?
e: Signed on 2 February 1971 in Ramsar (Iran), the Ramsar Convention promotes global conservation of Wetlands (आर्द्रभूमि संरक्षण). Exam Boosters: (1) World Wetlands Day is celebrated every year on 2 February; (2) Chilika Lake (Odisha) and Keoladeo National Park (Rajasthan) were India's first Ramsar sites (1981); (3) Montreux Record is a register of Ramsar sites facing ecological change (Keoladeo NP and Loktak Lake in India are listed); (4) Famous UP Ramsar sites include Upper Ganga River, Nawabganj, Saman, Samaspur, Sandi, Sarsai Nawar, Parvati Arga, Sur Sarovar, Haiderpur, and Bakhira.
qe: The Ramsar Convention (1971) is an intergovernmental treaty dedicated to the conservation and wise use of:

q:
निम्नलिखित प्रमुख भारतीय पर्यावरण अधिनियमों को उनके लागू होने के वर्ष से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. वन्यजीव (संरक्षण) अधिनियम — (a) 1986
2. जल (प्रदूषण निवारण एवं नियंत्रण) अधिनियम — (b) 1972
3. वायु (प्रदूषण निवारण एवं नियंत्रण) अधिनियम — (c) 1974
4. पर्यावरण (संरक्षण) अधिनियम — (d) 1981
e: Wildlife Protection Act = 1972; Water Act = 1974; Air Act = 1981; Environment Protection Act (umbrella legislation enacted after 1984 Bhopal Gas Tragedy) = 1986 (सही मिलान 1-b, 2-c, 3-d, 4-a है). Exam Boosters: (1) Forest (Conservation) Act = 1980; Biological Diversity Act = 2002; National Green Tribunal (NGT) Act = 2010; (2) Project Tiger was launched in 1973 and Project Elephant in 1992; (3) Bhopal Gas Tragedy (Dec 1984) involved leakage of Methyl Isocyanate (MIC, CH₃NCO); (4) CPCB (Central Pollution Control Board) was constituted under the Water Act, 1974.
qe:
Match the following landmark Indian Environmental Legislations with their year of enactment:
1. Wildlife (Protection) Act — (a) 1986
2. Water (Prevention & Control of Pollution) Act — (b) 1972
3. Air (Prevention & Control of Pollution) Act — (c) 1974
4. Environment (Protection) Act — (d) 1981

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन भारत में पाए जाने वाले चार मान्यता प्राप्त जैव विविधता हॉटस्पॉट (Biodiversity Hotspots) में से एक नहीं है?
e: India shares 4 of the world's 36 Biodiversity Hotspots: (1) The Himalayas, (2) Western Ghats (and Sri Lanka), (3) Indo-Burma region, and (4) Sundaland (includes Nicobar Islands). The Deccan Plateau is NOT a biodiversity hotspot (दक्कन का पठार जैव विविधता हॉटस्पॉट नहीं है). Exam Boosters: (1) The concept of Biodiversity Hotspots was coined by Norman Myers (1988); (2) Criteria: at least 1,500 endemic vascular plant species AND loss of at least 70% of original primary habitat; (3) Red Data Book of threatened species is published by IUCN (headquartered in Gland, Switzerland); (4) In-situ conservation includes National Parks, Wildlife Sanctuaries, and Biosphere Reserves; Ex-situ includes zoos, botanical gardens, and seed banks.
qe: Which of the following is NOT one of the four recognized Biodiversity Hotspots found in India?

q: किसी नदी या झील में उच्च जैविक ऑक्सीजन माँग (BOD) क्या दर्शाती है?
o: Pure drinking water with low bacteria
Heavy pollution by biodegradable organic waste
e: BOD measures the dissolved oxygen required by aerobic bacteria to decompose organic matter in water. High BOD indicates heavy organic pollution and low dissolved oxygen (उच्च BOD जैविक अपशिष्ट से भारी प्रदूषण को दर्शाता है). Exam Boosters: (1) Clean water has BOD < 5 ppm, whereas highly polluted water has BOD ≥ 17 ppm; (2) Eutrophication (सुपोषण) is excessive algal bloom caused by nitrate/phosphate fertilizer runoff, leading to oxygen depletion; (3) Minamata disease is caused by Mercury (Hg) poisoning, Itai-Itai by Cadmium (Cd), and Blue Baby Syndrome (Methemoglobinemia) by excess Nitrates in drinking water; (4) Arsenic contamination causes Blackfoot disease.
qe: High Biological Oxygen Demand (BOD) in a river or lake indicates:
oe: Pure drinking water with low bacteria
Heavy pollution by biodegradable organic waste

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी गैस क्योटो प्रोटोकॉल के अंतर्गत ग्रीनहाउस गैस (GHG) के रूप में वर्गीकृत नहीं है?
e: Atmospheric Nitrogen (N₂, ~78% of air) and Oxygen (O₂, ~21%) do not absorb infrared radiation and are NOT greenhouse gases (नाइट्रोजन ग्रीनहाउस गैस नहीं है). Exam Boosters: (1) The 6 original Kyoto Protocol GHGs are CO₂, CH₄, N₂O, HFCs, PFCs, and SF₆ (NF₃ was added later); (2) Water vapour is the most abundant natural GHG, while CO₂ is the largest anthropogenic contributor; (3) Paris Agreement (2015, COP21 under UNFCCC) aims to limit global warming well below 2°C and pursue efforts for 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels; (4) Lichens are natural bio-indicators of Sulphur dioxide (SO₂) air pollution.
qe: Which of the following gases is NOT classified as a Greenhouse Gas (GHG) under the Kyoto Protocol?

q:
प्रकाश-रासायनिक धूमकोहरा (लॉस एंजिल्स स्मॉग) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: यह गर्म, शुष्क और धूप वाली जलवायु में सूर्य के प्रकाश में नाइट्रोजन ऑक्साइड (NOₓ) और वाष्पशील कार्बनिक यौगिकों (VOCs) की अभिक्रिया से बनता है।
कथन II: क्षोभमंडलीय (जमीनी स्तर की) ओजोन और पेरोक्सीएसिटिल नाइट्रेट (PAN) इसके प्रमुख द्वितीयक प्रदूषक हैं।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Both statements are correct. Photochemical smog is oxidizing smog formed in sunny conditions from vehicular NOₓ + hydrocarbons, producing secondary pollutants like O₃ and PAN (दोनों कथन सही हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Classical (London) smog is reducing smog formed in cool, humid weather from smoke, fog, and SO₂; (2) Primary pollutants are emitted directly (CO, SO₂, NO), while secondary pollutants form via atmospheric reactions (O₃, PAN, H₂SO₄); (3) India's National Air Quality Index (NAQI) monitors 8 pollutants: PM₁₀, PM₂.₅, NO₂, SO₂, CO, O₃, NH₃, and Pb; (4) Catalytic converters in vehicles reduce CO, NOₓ, and unburnt hydrocarbons.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding Photochemical Smog (Los Angeles Smog):
Statement I: It forms in warm, dry, and sunny climates through reactions of nitrogen oxides (NOₓ) and volatile organic compounds (VOCs) in sunlight.
Statement II: Tropospheric (ground-level) ozone and Peroxyacetyl Nitrate (PAN) are major secondary pollutants in photochemical smog.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q:
UNFCCC के अंतर्गत पेरिस समझौते (2015) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर निर्धारित योगदान (NDC) स्वैच्छिक राष्ट्रीय जलवायु प्रतिबद्धताएँ हैं जिन्हें प्रत्येक पाँच वर्ष में अद्यतन किया जाता है।
कथन II: भारत के अद्यतन NDC में 2005 के स्तर से 2030 तक अपनी GDP की उत्सर्जन तीव्रता को 45% तक कम करने की प्रतिबद्धता है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Both statements are correct. Under the Paris Agreement (COP21), countries submit and ratchet up NDCs every 5 years; India's updated NDC commits to 45% reduction in GDP emissions intensity by 2030 (over 2005) and 50% cumulative electric power installed capacity from non-fossil sources by 2030 (दोनों कथन सही हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) UNFCCC (1992 Earth Summit, Rio de Janeiro) is the parent treaty for Kyoto Protocol and Paris Agreement; (2) India's 'Panchamrit' pledges (COP26, Glasgow) include Net Zero emissions by 2070; (3) International Solar Alliance (ISA), co-founded by India and France in 2015, is headquartered in Gurugram (Haryana); (4) IPCC (Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change) was established in 1988 by WMO and UNEP.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the Paris Agreement (2015) under UNFCCC:
Statement I: Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) are voluntary national climate pledges updated every five years.
Statement II: India's updated NDC commits to reducing the emissions intensity of its GDP by 45% by 2030 from the 2005 level.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
